fixes: Added the Inter-Club League match format: two clubs, per-club teams, a full cross-club league schedule, a Combined Leaderboard, optional Knockouts, and a Semifinal-or-Playoffs bracket through to a Grand Final and Bronze Medal result.
The Match Format picker moved from the Teams tab to the Players tab, and is now locked once a week has any players or teams (previously teams only).
Every auto-seeded matchup in the new format (Knockouts, Semifinals/Playoffs, Grand Final, Bronze) can be manually overridden from a dropdown before it's confirmed.
The prior Inter-Club Match format still works for existing weeks that used it, but is no longer offered for new weeks.
